charge_port.notes: The Charge Port: the Hummer EV has a CCS1 port that needs an adapter for Superchargers (tools section).

supercharger_access.notes: US: the GM/Honda-approved NACS adapter is needed on this CCS1 car; the model is on InsideEVs' list of non-Tesla EVs with Supercharger access. Current state for this model year.
